Name: Rolling Hills

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Description: Scales the overall height amplitude of the generated shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust the overall strength of this base shape.

Params.Name: Scale
Params.Description: Controls the scale of the coordinate space used by the shape.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values generally create smaller, more frequent features.

Params.Name: Octaves
Params.Description: Controls how many noise octaves contribute to the shape.
Params.Tooltip: More octaves add finer detail and increase generation cost.

Params.Name: Persistence
Params.Description: Controls how strongly successive noise octaves retain their amplitude.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values preserve more high-frequency detail.

Params.Name: Lacunarity
Params.Description: Controls how quickly the frequency changes between noise octaves.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values spread the octave frequencies farther apart.

Params.Name: RidgeAmount
Params.Label: Ridge Amount
Params.Tooltip: Increase this value for more pronounced ridge structure.
Params.Description: Controls how strongly the terrain is biased toward ridges.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Description: Selects the deterministic random pattern used by the generator.
Params.Tooltip: Change the seed to create a different reproducible layout.

Params.Name: Offset
Params.Description: Translates the sampling coordinates without changing the shape's scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use the offset to move through the procedural field.

Params.Name: Rotation
Params.Description: Rotates the shape's sampling coordinates around the terrain center.
Params.Tooltip: Use rotation to change the direction of directional features.

Description: Generates a rolling hills-style procedural base shape with controls for its main form and variation.
